indicators.label: Stated religion-response denominator
indicators.method: 2011: POPULATIA STABILA TOTAL minus Informatie nedisponibila. 2021: POPULATIA REZIDENTA TOTAL minus Informatie nedisponibila.
indicators.quality_notes: The denominator excludes undeclared or unavailable religion responses in each wave.

indicators.label: Religious affiliation percent
indicators.method: 100 * named-religion categories / stated religion-response denominator. The script computes the named-religion total as denominator minus Fara religie, Atei/Ateu, and 2021 Agnostic.
indicators.quality_notes: Rows with source suppression in a headline component are left unavailable rather than imputed.

indicators.label: No religion percent
indicators.quality_notes: The no-religion construct keeps the two source labels Fara religie and Atei/Ateu; 2021 Agnostic is documented separately and remains in the denominator.
